text: Robot Incident Room helps engineers investigate robot failures and review fixes together.
We start with a recorded robot run. A shared timeline helps the team inspect the same moment.
The engineer pins an observation to the telemetry.
A recorded AI diagnosis suggests restoring boot traction.
Alex proposes the change. Notice that Alex cannot approve their own fix.
We switch to Morgan, a separate reviewer identity. Morgan checks the evidence and adds a review comment.
Morgan approves. The decision is recorded with their name.
Back as Alex, we compare the historical result. This is a recorded single-seed comparison, not a fresh simulation.
The activity trail preserves each decision. Inspect together, review independently, and keep the evidence.
